description: This file defines the NextcloudAccountDialog class, a UI dialog for managing Nextcloud account credentials and authentication within an Android app. It handles user input, validation, and displays status messages based on authentication results.

classes.name: NextcloudAccountDialog
classes.description: A dialog class for user to input Nextcloud account credentials, validate, and display connection status.

methods.name: createBinding
methods.description: Creates and inflates the view binding for the dialog layout.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the dialog UI, loads saved credentials, and sets up the save button with authentication logic.
